subject: Viral clips of President Joe Biden at the G7 summit and a Los Angeles fundraiser
called_fake_by: White House Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre
claim: At a June 17 briefing, Jean-Pierre called the clips "cheap fakes" made in bad faith. She also used the word deepfakes.
finding: Both clips were real footage, not AI. G7: wider footage shows Biden turning toward a parachutist who was out of the cropped frame. Los Angeles: at the fundraiser, Biden paused while the crowd applauded, then left the stage with Barack Obama. The question in each case was framing and cropping, not authenticity.
outcome: "Cheap fake" became a campaign talking point. PolitiFact noted the term predated 2024 and refers to real footage that's been edited or stripped of context.

sources.title: 'Cheap fake' videos, and the phrase itself, take 2024 election's center stage
